notes: Todd Wenning is an investor with experience from Ensemble Capital, The Motley Fool, and Morningstar. In episode five, we came across some of his work as he is a contributing author to the book Why Moats Matter. This time, we speak about Lessons from the Titans, a book about the lessons that today’s businesses can draw from America’s industrial giants. For more info about the podcast, go to the episode page and make sure to follow us on Twitter/X . We love to hear your thoughts so please give us a rating/review in your podcast player!
